newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $24 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Sept 3.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $24 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Sept 3.

text.p: The Treasury Department said Tuesday it will auction $24 billion of three- and six-month bills on Sept 3 to pay down $5.975 billion as $29.975 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued Sept 5. The three-month bills mature December 5 and the six-month bills mature March 6, 1997.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127943R3 and for the six-month bills is 9127942M5.
